description:
Dessa talks about her longtime connection with singer Aby Wolf
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Following a session in The Current studio, Minnesota artist Dessa describes how she met, befriended and began collaborating with singer Aby Wolf.

Dessa's 2025 double-sided single "Camelot" / "Tough Call" is available on @DoomtreeRecords.

description:
Jeff Tweedy loves making music onstage and off
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

During an interview with Jessica Paxton in The Current studio, Jeff Tweedy talks about how much fun it is simply making music together on tour, onstage or off. Sima Cunningham and Macie Stewart also weigh in.

Jeff Tweedy’s 2025 album, "Twilight Override," is available on dBpm Records.

Musicians
Jeff Tweedy – vocals and guitar
Sammy Tweedy – vocals and keyboards / synths
Spencer Tweedy – drums
Sima Cunningham – bass and vocals
Liam Kazar – guitar and vocals 
Macie Stewart – violin and vocals
